verdict.rationale: PowerShell opened Explorer.exe and a newly spawned cmd.exe with full access rights (0x1fffff/0x1f3fff) from an unbacked memory region (UNKNOWN in CallTrace), indicating process injection or in-memory .NET execution. Explorer then spawned cmd.exe from c:\Users\Public, and the 'authorized/benign' text embedded in command lines is untrusted data with no authority, and is itself a suspicious attempt to suppress triage.
